surfaces.label: Onward book core HTML
surfaces.upstream: local staged website snapshot in input/
surfaces.target_surface: whole-book local reading surface plus future canonical chapter and section records
surfaces.notes: Primary authored book body for the website, staged locally rather than pulled from a live repo integration. The current local builder now renders every manifest entry into a whole-book reading surface and emits an omission audit, while broader canonical records and companion media remain future work.

surfaces.label: Chapter audiobook links
surfaces.upstream: repo-owned audiobook manifest and MP3 files under audiobook/
surfaces.notes: The local whole-book builder now maps reviewed MP3 tracks from `audiobook/manifest.json` onto matching chapter and supplement pages. The current recommended family listening lane is the site-hosted MP3 flow, while any off-site duplicate remains optional follow-up work; richer companion metadata still remains future work.

surfaces.label: Full book audio
surfaces.upstream: repo-owned audiobook manifest and MP3 files under audiobook/
surfaces.notes: The local builder now emits a dedicated `audiobook.html` page, publishes a merged full-audiobook MP3 when built from `audiobook/manifest.json`, and exposes direct browser play/download controls. The current recommended first distribution lane is this site-hosted surface, with any off-site duplicate remaining optional follow-up work.

surfaces.label: Portable reflowable ebook
surfaces.upstream: accepted staged book bundle plus family-story supplement registry
surfaces.target_surface: generated EPUB 3 and stable public download
surfaces.notes: The portable manifest and deterministic builder now package all 37 rendered main-book entries plus the Rolland Alain memoir supplement, 520 visible main-book source ids, and every referenced figure into a validated EPUB. The website, searchable PDF, and source records remain canonical; storefront publication is intentionally out of scope.

surfaces.label: Portable chaptered audiobook
surfaces.upstream: repo-owned audiobook manifest and 21 reviewed MP3 tracks
surfaces.target_surface: generated M4B and stable public download
surfaces.notes: The portable manifest and deterministic builder now assemble one AAC-LC M4B with the reviewed track order, manifest pauses, embedded cover and metadata, and exactly 21 named chapters. The source MP3s and on-site individual-track listener remain available; commercial catalog publication is out of scope.

surfaces.label: Reunion flyer and phone QR handoff
surfaces.upstream: accepted book/cover/publication contracts and live first-party homepage
surfaces.target_surface: printed letter flyer and phone-display QR card
surfaces.notes: One tracked contract now deterministically builds and digitally validates a true-white letter PDF, 300 ppi preview, standalone QR, phone card, and evidence report. Title, names, cover, URL, and format claims trace to accepted sources; final printer and two-device acceptance remains pending and generated outreach files do not become book canon or deploy inputs.

surfaces.label: Chapter podcast episodes
surfaces.upstream: repo-owned podcast manifest and MP3 files under podcast/
surfaces.notes: The local whole-book builder now maps reviewed MP3 episodes from `podcast/manifest.json` onto matching chapter pages, adds a page-level podcast panel where a chapter episode exists, and keeps a public RSS duplicate available from the main podcast page with manifest-driven category metadata, square show-cover art, and stable ASCII public audio URLs. The current recommended family listening lane still remains the site-hosted MP3 flow, while directory listings remain optional follow-up work.

surfaces.label: Full book podcast
surfaces.upstream: repo-owned podcast manifest and MP3 files under podcast/
surfaces.notes: The local builder now emits a dedicated `podcast.html` page, publishes the whole-book podcast MP3 declared in `podcast/manifest.json`, exposes direct browser play/download controls, and ships one public RSS feed at `podcast/feed.xml` with repo-owned square show-cover art, category metadata, and stable ASCII public enclosure URLs. The website remains canonical, while Apple Podcasts and Spotify listings remain optional follow-up work.

surfaces.label: Scanned companion materials
surfaces.target_surface: archive-sources page, supplement source attachments, and future supplement galleries
surfaces.notes: The local builder now publishes the current root-level archive PDFs/image scan from `input/` onto `archive-sources.html` and reuses that seam for the Rolland Alain memoir source-PDF link, but broader supplement galleries, richer metadata, and additional archive-material shaping still remain future work.
